WEB_CSV_009: NOT EXECUTED 2026-09-09 — the platform could not accept an upload. POST /uploads/sessions/{id}/complete answered 503 {"reason":"upload-retention-unavailable","message":"The file was uploaded, but protected retention storage is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was imported. Retry completion after storage is restored.","retryAfterSeconds":60}. Roughly 16 attempts across 50 minutes all answered the same, with the session POST and the S3 PUT both succeeding first, so the failure is the retention step alone. These two were briefly recorded as "fail" by mistake: the assertion message named neither the status nor the reason, so the shared infrastructure classifier could not recognise the outage and both recorders wrote a verdict. import-jobs.page.ts now puts the status and the response body in the message, which is what the classifier reads. Re-run when storage is restored.
